messages:
marta: FYI — after the 22:00 rollout (commit abc123def) a handful of longctx hosts started trending up in RSS and some hit OOMs. mid-size sequences (512-1024) look worst. :eyes:
alex: seeing the same on perf cluster-3. memory growth looks correlated with kv compaction activity spikes.
rick: alerted by SRE pager at 22:12, autoscale helped but we should avoid a full rollback if possible. any quick mitigations?
jasmine: quick data point: CI perf gate flagged 3 regressions earlier today (latency + mem). linking job: https://ci.internal/jobs/8732 — kernel-router change was included in the same merge set.
marta: timeline pinned them together, ran a quick bisect between abc123def..def456ghi and it points to PR #4572 (slab compactor rewrite + deferred-free list).
lisa: hmm the compactor now keeps small slab fragments on a per-worker holdlist for 5s before returning to the global freelist. idea was to reduce lock churn but looks like fragmentation increases for mixed seqlen workloads.
alex: attached quick pprof of runtime on an affected host:`
```
allocs: total 1.2G allocs
  slab_frag_small: 420M (35%)
  kv_cache_chunks: 520M (43%)
  deferred_holdlist: 190M (16%)
  other: 70M (6%)
```
rick: that deferred_holdlist number (+190M) is the smoking gun. if those are not actually freed because kernel-router holds references to tiny-chunks, they accumulate.
jasmine: also saw sequence-length distribution change for a subset of traffic (more 700-900 tokens after new batching heuristics rolled). interplay seems nasty.
marta: proposed action: 1) hold rollout (stopped canary at 50%), 2) revert PR #4572 on canaries and re-run CI perf gates, 3) add extra freeing path to drain holdlists on compaction if global memory pressure high. thoughts? :+1: or alternative?
alex: agree. quick revert will show if memory stabilizes. I can push revert and a small probe that forces early drain under mem_pressure.
ci-bot: perf-gate: triggered failure for job 8732, regression delta +18% RSS at 95th. Snapshot saved to s3://perf-artifacts/8732/abc123def/profile.pb
deploy-bot: canaries paused at 50% per request from marta. rollback approval required from release lead to revert.
rick: SRE prefers a revert then gradual reintroduce with feature-flag off for compactor. also add an infra metric: holdlist_bytes gauge per worker.
lisa: wrote a small reproducer that streams 512..1024 token requests with mixed batching. running it on a spare node now. if we can reproduce in lab we avoid a full revert in prod.
marta: timeline: alex to open revert PR + drain-probe (T+15m). jasmine to re-run CI perf gate on revert head. rick to add temp alert for holdlist_bytes > 50MB. if revert removes growth we close incident and iterate on compactor design.
alex: created revert PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4680 — includes probe; tests queued.
jasmine: CI replay queued, will post results in this thread.
marta: thanks. tagging for postmortem: we'll capture sequencing sensitivity and kernel-router interaction, and make compactor heuristics workload-aware before re-landing. :memo:
